args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release. Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — verified rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged on-call.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — verified rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged on-call.
